title: Short and Partial Payments: Merchandise Paid For in a Commercial Credit Account Catch-Up Discount
content:
**Cash application standard — Commercial Credit Account.** This standard sets **the merchandise the payment pays for** in a catch-up prompt-payment discount on an invoice dated inside the current term, from its effective date through its expiration date, of the customer's live Contract Pricing Agreement (its one agreement whose status is active or renewal pending).

### Rule

A payment that leaves open on its invoice no more than the tier's prompt-payment discount percentage of that invoice's merchandise subtotal counts as payment of the full remaining balance, and for a payment on such an invoice the merchandise it pays for is set by the allocation below, in place of the test of the full remaining balance less the discount and the pro rata share of a partial payment.

When more is left open than the tier's prompt-payment discount percentage of the invoice's merchandise subtotal and the tier allows partial-payment discounts, the payment is taken to settle the invoice's freight and sales tax first, so the merchandise it pays for is the payment less the invoice's freight and sales tax, never below nothing; when more is left open than that and the tier does not allow partial-payment discounts, the merchandise it pays for is nothing; otherwise it pays for the whole merchandise subtotal.

The payment is the amount of the account's latest payment entry applied to that invoice. What is left open is the invoice total less every payment, credit memo, discount line and write-off applied to the invoice, plus every returned payment reversed on it, compared without rounding.

### Allocation table

| Left open on the invoice | Tier allows partial-payment discounts | Merchandise the payment pays for |
|---|---|---|
| more than the tier's percentage of the merchandise subtotal | yes | the payment less the invoice's freight and sales tax, never below nothing |
| more than that | no | nothing |
| no more than that | either | the whole merchandise subtotal |

### Cases (hypothetical: 1 percent tier; merchandise 2000.00, freight 100.00, sales tax 140.00, total 2240.00)

- Payment 2220.00 leaves 20.00 open, exactly 1 percent of 2000.00: the whole 2000.00 is paid for.
- Payment 2219.99 leaves 20.01 open on a tier allowing partial-payment discounts: 2219.99 less 240.00, so 1979.99.
- Payment 1500.00 on such a tier: 1500.00 less 240.00, so 1260.00.
- Payment 200.00 on such a tier: 200.00 less 240.00 falls below nothing, so nothing.
- Payment 1500.00 on a tier not allowing partial-payment discounts: nothing.
